window.method: native crop ceil(fs*before/after); segment-local polyphase resample to144Hz with constant boundary; interpolate onto exact common time grid; mean/std per beat. No whole-record fit. Expert annotations; INCART timing not manually corrected. No fitted time offset.

train_sampling.selection: deterministic hash smallest; train-only cap, never validation/test; SVDB record unit is not a verified subject

gate.scope: Unchanged assistant engineering gate on pooled development OOF and each fold; not clinical or competition standard.

training.selection: mean of3 fold validation macro-F1; tie lower mean validation CE; no independent test access

source_policy: Only verified MIT MLII auxiliary + INCART II development; preserves v8 residual_verified exact model inputs; no SVDB/LTDB, no parent cache, no independent test reader.
evaluation: Each fold validation INCART subjects held out from that fit; natural prevalence, no cap. Training caps applied inside each fold only. All26 patients previously used for development, OOF is development cross-validation, not a fresh independent test.
test_policy: Do not load or evaluate independent6 patients in this script. Any later final fit/test requires explicit frozen procedure after CV passes; do not treat an individual fold model as full-data final.
reproduction: Derived Git entry for one already-evaluated candidate, not a new model result or a new independent test. Immutable v8 retained. Download names and file hashes frozen here.
